content.heroText: Fresh plates, warm drinks and a calm corner to enjoy them. From a slow breakfast to a sweet afternoon treat, there is always a seat for you at Al Hara.
content.aboutTitle: A calm corner for good food
content.aboutText:
Al Hara Cafeteria is a place to slow down. Pull up a chair, order something warm or something cold, and enjoy food made fresh for you.

We keep the menu simple and the atmosphere easy. It is a spot for a quiet breakfast, a lunch with friends, or an afternoon coffee with something sweet.

menu.name: Fresh Lemonade
menu.desc: Freshly squeezed lemon over ice with a hint of mint. Cool, sharp and refreshing.

menu.name: Masala Chai
menu.desc: Strong tea simmered with warming spices and milk, served piping hot.

menu.name: Iced Coffee
menu.desc: Cold coffee layered with milk and topped with a swirl of cream.

menu.name: Club Sandwich
menu.desc: Toasted bread stacked with chicken, egg, lettuce and tomato, held together with a pick.

menu.name: Chicken Wrap
menu.desc: Warm tortilla rolled around grilled chicken, crisp vegetables and a creamy sauce.

menu.name: Creamy Pasta
menu.desc: Tender pasta in a rich tomato and cream sauce, finished with fresh basil.

menu.name: Garden Salad
menu.desc: Crisp greens, tomato, cucumber and olives with a light dressing.

menu.name: Fluffy Pancakes
menu.desc: A tall stack of soft pancakes with butter, syrup and berries.

menu.name: Chocolate Cake
menu.desc: Layers of moist chocolate sponge and cream under a smooth pink frosting.

menu.name: Fudge Brownie
menu.desc: Dense, gooey chocolate brownie dusted with powdered sugar.
